jobs.description: A label of houseofwork.nl  Logistics Worker Do you enjoy active work and working with a team? As a Logistics Worker, you help load, unload and sort parcels. You make sure parcels are ready to continue to their destination. Bring your motivation and help your colleagues get the daily work done in this full-time role.
